worldcombat.skill.waterpledge.summary: Drive a Water Pledge into chosen ground: a pillar of water surges up, pushing, lifting and slowing the enemies inside, and the base leaves a waterlogged pledge scar. If a fire or grass pledge scar already lies near the point, the vows answer: the strike is far heavier and the point becomes a rainbow (water + fire, which keeps healing allies) or a wetland (water + grass, which roots and heavily slows those who step in).
worldcombat.skill.waterpledge.descriptio: The pillar surges up at the chosen point, dealing about %1$s special damage to each of up to %2$s enemies inside.
The column has a radius of %1$s blocks and is %2$s blocks tall.
Enemies inside are pushed %1$s blocks away from the centre and lifted at %2$s blocks per tick, and are slowed for %3$s (movement speed about 15%% lower).

The base leaves a waterlogged pledge scar with a radius of %1$s blocks, lasting %2$s; enemies standing on it are continually slowed (movement speed about 15%% lower), and the slow fades within about 2 seconds of stepping off.

If a fire or grass pledge scar lies within %1$s blocks, the two vows resonate: this strike's power is x%2$s, and the point grows a combined field whose radius is about %3$s times the scar's - a rainbow (water + fire) or a wetland (water + grass).
worldcombat.skill.waterpledge.deluge.on: Deluge vow: pillar power x1.10, scar x1.2, push x1.25 and combined-field radius x1.15, at the cost of range x0.9 and cooldown +12.
worldcombat.skill.waterpledge.deluge.off: Calm flow: range x1.1 and cooldown -4, at the cost of pillar power x0.96, scar x0.85, push x0.9 and combined-field radius x0.95.
worldcombat.skill.waterpledge.timing: Cast range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.waterpledge.use.0: Raise a water pillar on distant ground and push foes back
worldcombat.skill.waterpledge.use.1: Soak a patch of ground with a waterlogged pledge scar
worldcombat.skill.waterpledge.use.2: Combine with a fire or grass pledge into a rainbow or a wetland
worldcombat.skill.waterpledge.preference: On (deluge vow): pillar power x1.10, scar x1.2, push x1.25 and combined-field radius x1.15, but range x0.9 and cooldown +12 - surges harder and wider, yet you must stand closer and recover slower. Off (calm flow): range x1.1 and cooldown -4, but pillar power x0.96, scar x0.85, push x0.9 and combined-field radius x0.95 - farther and faster, with a lighter surge and a smaller field.
The companion only raises a water pillar while the threat is within this distance; beyond it, it closes in first.
worldcombat.skill.waterpledge.growth.0: From level %1$s the pillar gains another step with level (about %2$s).
worldcombat.skill.waterpledge.descriptio: A rainbow keeps healing allies standing inside; a wetland roots enemies who step in for about 1.5 seconds (unable to move but still able to act) and keeps them heavily slowed (movement speed about 45% lower). The combined field lasts about 60% longer than the scar.
